evidence.label: 描述任务、问题或评测环境
evidence.excerpt: We propose user behavior as supervision and introduce Vela, a framework that converts real user behavior data into trainable tasks and trajectories.

evidence.label: 给出任务规模或覆盖范围
evidence.excerpt: From the anonymized behavior records of 100,000 users, Vela generates 100,000 tasks across 91 real-world task templates; difficulty-based filtering and trajectory acceptance criteria retain approximately 75,000 tasks with selected training trajectories.
